_about: Per-frame canvas profiles for gfx.py `size --profile` and the `families` check. Every row cites its source; the deterministic-tooling plan (docs/plans/repo_cleanup/deterministic_tooling_plan_2026-10-25.md) records decisions D1-D3. `accepted` lists every size the families check treats as valid; `canvas` is the size for new art; `margin` is the minimum transparent margin in pixels for `size`.

focus.source: D1 (user decision, 25 October 2026): 94x86 for new art (3,342 Chaos Redux focus icons); vanilla's 100x88 (2,680 of 2,951 vanilla goals) stays valid, a new or changed 100x88 file is a warning, and any other size is an error. Margin from the October 2026 GFX repair task.

decision.source: D2 (user decision, 25 October 2026): 32x32 for new art (event-assets skill; 1,722 Chaos Redux files); 33x32 (vanilla's commonest, 179 of 518) and 34x34 (October 2026 repair task) stay valid; other sizes are warnings. Margin from the October 2026 GFX repair task.
